scope: Complete construction wrapper with caller-supplied nonnull storage and nonnull identity, real in-capacity pair append, finalizer, registration and resolver. Constructor callback is synthetic and sets target word; protected entry/exit adapters execute through patched encoded slots to synthetic recursive-lock APIs; fixed-size copy, map services and TLS intercepted. Checks pre-callback header, published pair, lock release, return target and final registry state. No real constructor, allocation or concurrency.
